remarks: Stunning Cedar A-Frame retreat on just under 10 acres is waiting for you to call it home! Discover the perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort in this meticulously maintained 2208 sq ft A-frame home. Thie property offers a rare opportunity for a peaceful living environment with a versatile space for guests or hobbies. The homes core is crafted from premium Western Red Cedar imported from Canada providing a timeless, warm aesthetic. The property was thoughtfully expanded in 2016 with high-quality White Cedar additions adding a formal dining room and 3 bedrooms. This home offers 3 generous bedrooms including a convenient main level bedroom, a primary bedroom with a full bath and a second full bath on the first floor.  The newly updated kitchen is open to the main living area providing the perfect space for togetherness! The outbuilding/garage offers a converted cottage unique to this property. Fully insulated with its own electric service providing a perfect spot for guests, an in-law apartment or hobby area. There are two small ponds on the property that do need a bit of attention, but beautiful nonetheless! This property is a must see of those seeking privacy, character and move in ready convenience!
